data.long_meaning: Anuraag is derived from the Sanskrit root 'anu' meaning towards and 'raga' meaning passion, desire or emotion. The name signifies the deep love, affection and passion one feels towards someone or something. The name Anuraag carries the meaning “Love, affection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anuraag usually hope their child will grow to embody love, affection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
